import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    
    if n == 0:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    arr1 = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    arr2 = list(map(int, data[1+n:1+2*n]))
    
    result = [arr1[i] + arr2[i] for i in range(n)]
    
    print(' '.join(map(str, result)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
